ContactsNewContactDialog.description: Add a person to your contacts. These contacts will be shared with everyone in this workspace.
ContactsNewContactDialog.businessCardDescription: Take a photo of the card or upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP, then check every detail. Connex reads the card itself when it can. If it can't, the image goes to your organization's AI provider to be read. A copy of the image is saved with the contact.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardScanReady: Details added. Review them before creating the contact.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardManualFallback: Scanning stopped. Keep the image and enter the details manually.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardManualOnly: Automatic reading isn't available. Keep the image and enter the details manually.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardSelectionUnsupported: Choose a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image. The current selection, if any, was kept.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardWarningLowConfidence: Some details have low confidence. Review them carefully.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardWarningPartial: Only part of the card was recognized. Enter any missing details.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardWarningOrientation: The card angle made some details harder to read.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardWarningNoFields: No contact details were recognized. Enter them manually.

ContactsNewContactDialog.cardErrorForbidden: You don't have permission to scan or import this card.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardErrorTooLarge: This image is too large. Choose a smaller image.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardErrorUnsupportedType: Choose a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardErrorUnreadable: The card could not be read. Keep the image and enter the details manually.

ContactsNewContactDialog.cardErrorTimeout: Scanning took too long. Try again or enter the details manually.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardErrorUnavailable: Card scanning is unavailable. You can still enter the details manually.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardErrorRejected: This card could not be scanned. You can enter the details manually.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardErrorFailed: The card could not be scanned. Try again or enter the details manually.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorUnauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again, then create the contact.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorForbidden: You don't have permission to save card images.

ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorImage: Couldn't save this image. Choose another, or continue without it.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorImageRequired: Couldn't save this image with the new company. Choose another JPEG, PNG, or WebP and try again.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorBusy: Card import is busy. Try creating the contact again in a moment.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorConflict: Couldn't confirm whether the contact was created. Leave the details as they are and try again.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorUnavailable: Couldn't confirm whether the contact was created. Leave the details as they are and try again — Connex will check before creating a second one.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorRecoveryStorage: Your browser is blocking storage, so the card wasn't imported. Allow storage for this site and try again.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorRejected: The card could not be imported with these details. Review the highlighted fields and try again.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorFailed: Couldn't confirm whether the contact was created. Leave the details as they are and try again — Connex will check before creating a second one.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportRecoveryFailed: Couldn't check on an earlier scan. Look for that person in your contacts before scanning the card again. You can still add someone else.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportRecoveryStorageUnavailable: Card scanning is off because your browser is blocking storage. You can still add the contact by hand.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportRecovered: The contact from your earlier card import was created.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportRecoveredExisting: The card from your earlier import was attached to the existing contact.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportRecoveryGone: Can't tell what happened to an earlier scan. Look for that person in your contacts before scanning the card again.

ContactRestrictions.provisionHint: Blocks new shares with other workspaces and keeps this contact out of AI features.
ContactRestrictions.provisionWarning: Saving immediately ends every share of this contact with another workspace.
